title: minuartia fastigiata subsp. rostrata
intro: Minuartia fastigiata subsp. rostrata, commonly known as the narrow-leaved sandwort, is a plant species within the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae) characterized by its narrow leaves and pink to white flowers. The narrow-leaved sandwort has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal properties, making it a potential treatment for wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of Minuartia fastigiata subsp. rostrata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
